literal: Family having perished fault will increase, laziness having yielded to, excellent effort to those without.
translation: For those who yield to laziness and lack excellent effort, their family will perish and their faults will multiply.
modern: சோம்பலில் வீழ்ந்து சிறந்த முயற்சி இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு, அவர்களின் குடி அழிந்து குற்றங்கள் பெருகும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the destructive consequences of laziness on one's lineage and character. The word 'மடி' means laziness, and yielding to it prevents a person from making the excellent effort needed to succeed. Consequently, their family's standing is destroyed and their personal flaws and failures multiply.
